verdict.rationale: Bento documents a 'Send webhook' action that fires from automation workflows when an external system should act, showing outbound webhook capability exists, but there's no evidence of a dedicated webhook subscription system for specific delivery/engagement events (sends, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes) nor any documentation of payload signing/verification. missing for 10: documented list of subscribable event types, signed payload/signature verification docs, dedicated webhook subscription endpoint or settings page.
